Cheese Cat-Astrophe Starring Speedy Gonz.name: Cheese Cat-Astrophe starring Speedy Gonzales
Cheese Cat-Astrophe Starring Speedy Gonz.summary: Sylvester's alter ego, the dastardly Dr. Cheesefinger, has "kidnapped" the cheese supply and Speedy Gonzales' girlfriend, Carmel. Can this "speedy-mouse" outwit the callous cat and rescue the village cheese supply?

Fantastic Dizzy.name: Fantastic Dizzy
Fantastic Dizzy.summary: Dizzy is an egg living in a world of magic and fantasy. The basic concept of the game is to move around the world, finding various items and collectibles, and to use them in the right locations. Dizzy has no special skills or abilities, save for his remarkable feats of somersaulting, and must solve all problems he faces with the clever use of one or more items.

Garfield - Caught in the Act.name: Garfield: Caught in the Act
Garfield - Caught in the Act.summary: Odie scares Garfield while they are watching television and they fall on the TV, breaking it. Both characters attempt to repair it before Jon Arbuckle catches them; however, the thrown spare parts become an electronic monster known as the Glitch, transporting Garfield into the TV. Players take control of the titular cat across levels of varying themes on the television in order to defeat the Glitch and escape the TV.

Sassou Shounen Eiyuuden - Coca-Cola Kid.name: Sassou Shounen Eiyuuden: Coca-Cola Kid
Sassou Shounen Eiyuuden - Coca-Cola Kid.summary:
Coca-Cola kid is a sidescroller starring the Coca-Cola Kid, the Coke mascot in Japan in the 1990's.
Cokey must hit the streets and take on Team Evil who just went and kidnapped his teacher, Ms. Sakurako. Skate through the city and be brave!

Smurfs, The.name: The Smurfs
Smurfs, The.summary: Platform game where you will be able to play with the jockey smurf, the brainy smurf, the greedy smurf and the hefty smurf to resolve the adventure.
